title: Lisse coefficients on an open relative affine line over an integer model
statement: Let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring. Work in the bounded-below derived categories of sheaves of $\Lambda$-modules on small etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories] [def-weil-pbc-direct-image]. For any separated finite-type morphism $h:T\to B$ of quasi-compact and quasi-separated schemes [def-pc-scheme] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], a compactification $c=(j:T\hookrightarrow\overline T,p:\overline T\to B)$ consists of a quasi-compact open immersion $j$ and a proper morphism $p$ with $h=pj$ [def-weil-pbc-projection-compactification]; write $Rh_!^c=Rp_*j_!$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. Let $Y=\operatorname{Spec}R$ for a finitely generated $\mathbf Z$-algebra $R$ (a commutative ring generated by finitely many elements as a ring). Let $U\subseteq\mathbf A^1_Y$ be an open subscheme [def-nagata-relative-affine-space], let $f:U\to Y$ be the restricted projection, and let $L$ be a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $U_{\Et}$ locally isomorphic on an etale cover to constant sheaves of finite $\Lambda$-modules [def-constructible-locally-constant] [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf]. Regard $L$ as a complex in degree zero. For every compactification $c$ of $f$ and every $q\in\mathbf Z$, $\mathcal H^q(Rf_!^cL)$ is constructible on $Y_{\Et}$ [def-weil-derived-cohomology-sheaves].

proof.text: Finite type over the integers makes the base and affine line Noetherian. The open source is Noetherian and separated. Convert the finite-module-values hypothesis to IsFiniteLocallyConstantSheaf. A finite affine open cover exists, and pairwise intersections of affine opens are affine.

source.place: Tag 0GKY, lemma-loc-constant-shriek-rel-dim-1: finite etale prime-torsion argument; Tag 0GKX, lemma-constant-shriek-rel-dim-1

proof.text: For fixed compactification, let Q be the triangulated property that every cohomology sheaf is constructible. Its restriction along the single-complex functor and compactified shriek contains zero and is closed under short exact sequences. Convert constructibility using the module-sheaf comparison. The Plus short-exact triangle and Serre closure supply these facts.

source.place: Tag 0GKY, lemma-loc-constant-shriek-rel-dim-1: finite etale prime-torsion argument; Tag 0GKX, lemma-constant-shriek-rel-dim-1

proof.text: Reduce an affine restriction to sheaves killed by a prime. Strongly induct on a positive additive annihilator n, initially ringChar(Lambda), which is positive since Lambda is finite. If n=1 the sheaf is zero. Otherwise choose a prime p dividing n=p*m. The kernel K of p on F is killed by p, and F/K is killed by m<n. Both are finite locally constant, by kernel and cokernel closure over the finite Noetherian coefficient ring. The short-exact triangle combines the prime case for K with induction for F/K.

source.place: Tag 0GKY, lemma-loc-constant-shriek-rel-dim-1: finite etale prime-torsion argument; Tag 0GKX, lemma-constant-shriek-rel-dim-1

proof.text: An affine open restriction of the relative line is affine over the affine base and smooth of relative dimension one: its open immersion is etale and smooth of relative dimension zero, and the affine-line projection has relative dimension one. Apply the prime-torsion affine-curve lemma to each prime case for every cohomological degree and the given restricted compactification.

source.place: Tag 0GKY, lemma-loc-constant-shriek-rel-dim-1: finite etale prime-torsion argument; Tag 0GKX, lemma-constant-shriek-rel-dim-1

proof.text: Define P(W) by quantifying over all open immersions with image W, all finite locally constant sheaves and all compactifications. The affine case just proved gives P on affine opens. Relative Mayer-Vietoris and the triangulated property Q give P(U union V) from P(U), P(V), and P(U intersection V). Pullback preserves finite local constancy; exact pullback commutes with the degree-zero single functor. Cohomology preserves binary biproducts and constructible sheaves are closed under them. Induct on the size of a finite affine cover. Intersecting with the newly inserted affine open gives a cover with at most the preceding size; its members are affine by separatedness. The empty cover is the empty affine open. Apply P(top) to the identity immersion and the prescribed compactification.
